findings.source: InitializableStorage { uint64 _initialized; bool _initializing; } at 0xf0c5..6a00; V3Provider: resilientOracle (address) and accountingAssetDecimals (uint8) share slot 0
findings.issue: Field boundaries are taken from how the compiler wrote whole words: _initialized/_initializing become a uint72 plus a uint184 (and _initialized is written byte-wise), slot 0 gets a phantom uint88 field at bit 168 that is only ever rewritten with its own old value, and the whole-slot read prints the slot as 0x111f..aa0 * 3600.
findings.rule: Split a slot by the widest typed accesses the code makes (uint64 at 0, bool at 64); a store of a slot's unchanged remainder (x = stor[s] ... field = x >> k) is not a field write and needs no field; never apply time-unit factoring to a slot number.

findings.function: deposit((...)), withdraw((...)), supplyShares, withdrawShares, redeemShares, rebalance, compound and the other nonReentrant functions
findings.issue: Scratch stores the via-IR code makes while computing the namespaced slot are printed although each is overwritten before any read (60 such lines).
findings.rule: A store overwritten before any read of the same bytes is dead.

notes: 84 ABI functions, most short (ERC4626/ERC20 views, role-gated setters); the long ones (deposit/withdraw/supply/redeem paths, rebalance, compound, liquidate, initialize) read by structure. Source loop: bulkSyncUserBalance for (1418), shown as while; getRoleMembers' storage copy (692) is implicit. The daily-loss window uses block.timestamp / (24 * 3600) correctly. Parameter names of initialize come from an unrelated database entry (_bZxContract, _loanTokenAddress...). 3 calls print their selector as a memory slice (see c00480).
summary: A close and readable text with the single source loop found; its main defects are storage-field boundaries inferred from whole-word writes (Initializable storage, a phantom field in slot 0, a slot printed as a multiple of 3600) and dead scratch stores.
